subject: AcmeCloud security request: access controls & scoped IAM artifacts (SSO/SCIM/RBAC)
messages:
From: Jared Bloom <jared.bloom@acmecloud.com>
To: olga.petrov@redwood.ai
Cc: security_ops@acmecloud.com
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Access controls artifacts request (SSO/SCIM/RBAC)

Hi Olga,

Thanks again for the quick intro call last week. As part of AcmeCloud's SIG intake for our security review, we need a focused set of artifacts to validate your access controls and provisioning posture. To keep the scope small, can you provide the following by COB Thursday (2027-06-17)?

- SCIM export (CSV or JSON) for active users in the last 90 days (fields: user_id, external_id, email, active, groups)
- SAML metadata (IdP/SP metadata XML) and an example SAML assertion (PII redacted)
- RBAC role-to-permission mapping (CSV) and a snapshot of roles assigned to service accounts
- Provisioning/provision-change logs for March 2027 -> June 2027 (timestamps + actor + action) — redaction OK for internal IDs
- A short note describing how least-privilege is enforced for operator/service accounts and any just-in-time flows

If you need to redact mailbox addresses or internal hostnames, we can accept pseudonymized exports as long as the mapping is consistent across artifacts. We may follow up with one short clarifying question after review.

Thanks — Jared
Jared Bloom
Security Engineer, AcmeCloud
security@acmecloud.com
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>

Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Access controls artifacts request (SSO/SCIM/RBAC)

Jared — thanks for the clear list, we can get most of this ready. High-level plan below and owners.

Planned deliverables (target: 2027-06-16 EOD PT):
- SCIM export (scim_user_export_20270614.csv) — owner: Laura Bennett (IAM team)
- SAML metadata + example assertion (saml_metadata.xml) — owner: Marcus Lin (Platform Auth)
- RBAC role matrix (rbac_matrix_olga_review.csv) — owner: me (Security PM)
- Provisioning change logs (provisioning_logs_202703-202706.zip) — owner: Laura; will include pseudonymized actor ids
- Short control note: least-privilege for service accounts and JIT gating (attached as acme_q_and_a.xlsx) — owner: Olga

Quick clarifications we have for scope:
1) Do you need the full SCIM history (all changes) or just a current snapshot + last activity? We can provide both but history is larger.
2) For provisioning logs, we will pseudonymize internal email addresses and hostnames. Will that meet your requirements?

We will upload artifacts to the Drive link below and share a short summary doc with redaction notes. If you prefer a signed SAML metadata URL instead of XML attachment, let us know.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3c-acme-iam-evidence
HubSpot ticket: ACME-9821

I'll send the first bundle by tomorrow morning.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Security Program Manager

OLGA / Marcus — prepping the SCIM export now. A few internal notes (for the thread):

- SCIM export will include: id, externalId, userName(email), active(boolean), groups(comma-delimited), lastModifiedDate
- I'll also include a small mapping file if we pseudonymize email addresses (mapping stored locally).
- Provisioning logs: export will include event_time, actor_id (pseudonymized), action, target_user_id, source (UI/API). Can reduce window to 90 days if Acme only needs that.

Marcus: can you confirm the example SAML assertion will have only attributes we allow to share (name, email, groups) and no auditing headers? If so I'll attach the export to the Drive folder and mark files that must be redacted.

Laura
Senior IAM Engineer

Olga / team — this looks great, thanks for the checklist and timeline. A couple follow-ups:

- SCIM: current snapshot + last activity is fine for our review. No need for full change history unless we request it later.
- Logs: pseudonymized actor IDs are acceptable; please include a short redaction mapping file (kept in the Drive folder).
- SAML assertion: the attributes you listed are fine; please strip any internal audit headers.
- RBAC: if you can include examples of service accounts with minimal scopes that would be helpful (we don't need account secrets, just role assignment evidence).

If you can drop the first bundle tomorrow morning, we'll do an initial pass and get back with clarifying Qs (if any). If anything changes on timing, we're flexible to extend to Friday.

Appreciate the fast turnaround — Jared
